categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in three primary business segments: (1) Surgical treatment products, primarily intraocular lenses (IOLs) for cataract surgery under the 'Prunol' brand; (2) Myopia control products, including orthokeratology lenses ('Prunol' brand), defocus lenses, and daily wear rigid contact lenses; (3) Vision care products, including soft contact lenses (transparent and colored) and related care solutions. The company also provides contract manufacturing services for contact lenses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies including: (1) Medical high-polymer material technology for developing biocompatible materials with specific properties; (2) Ophthalmic lens optical design technology for precision optical systems; (3) Functional structure design for implantable devices; (4) Ultra-precision machining technology with surface precision below 10 nanometers; (5) Surface modification technology including heparin coating and plasma treatment. Manufacturing employs GMP standards, ISO9001, ISO13485 certifications, and CE compliance for European markets.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include public and private hospitals, eye care clinics, and vision centers across China (covering over 6,000 medical institutions). The company also serves consumers through direct sales and e-commerce channels for contact lens products. End markets include cataract surgery patients, myopic youth requiring vision correction, and consumers seeking vision care products. Geographic markets span China (95.83% of revenue) and international markets including Europe, Asia, Africa, South America, and Australia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Beijing and production facilities in Yantai (Shandong Province) and Suzhou. International presence includes distribution in over 30 countries across Europe (Germany, France, Italy, UK, Switzerland), Asia (Korea, Thailand, Malaysia), Africa, South America (Colombia), and Australia. The company established a Hong Kong subsidiary and is expanding global operations through GDR issuance and strategic partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: (1) Upstream - develops and manufactures core materials and components; (2) Midstream - produces finished medical devices (IOLs, contact lenses); (3) Downstream - distributes through direct sales to hospitals/clinics and indirect sales through distributors and e-commerce channels. The company maintains control over material sourcing, manufacturing, and quality assurance while utilizing third-party logistics for distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Advancing surgical treatment products with new designs (EDoF, toric multifocal IOLs, phakic IOLs); (2) Expanding myopia control product portfolio with improved materials and designs; (3) Developing high-comfort silicone hydrogel contact lenses; (4) Expanding into adjacent medical device categories (hyaluronic acid gels, tissue repair products); (5) International market expansion in Europe and Southeast Asia; (6) Building e-commerce and consumer channels for vision care products. R&D investment was 13.91% of revenue in 2023.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Product sales via direct sales to hospitals/clinics and indirect sales through distributors (67.08% of revenue from distribution channel); (2) Direct sales to end consumers through vision centers and e-commerce platforms (23.36% of revenue); (3) Contract manufacturing/OEM services for contact lens products (9.56% of revenue). Revenue is primarily from product sales with payment terms negotiated per customer type.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the market leader in China's IOL market by self-produced brand shipment volume (2022 data). Key competitors in surgical products include multinational manufacturers (Alcon, Bausch+Lomb, Johnson & Johnson). In myopia control, competitors include other orthokeratology lens manufacturers. In contact lenses, competitors include international brands and domestic manufacturers. The company differentiates through indigenous R&D, quality, and rapid market responsiveness compared to imported alternatives.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2023 financial performance: Revenue of 951.18 million RMB (64.14% YoY growth), net profit of 303.98 million RMB (30.63% YoY growth), total assets of 3,061.79 million RMB (36.42% YoY growth). The company has demonstrated consistent growth trajectory with 2021-2023 revenue CAGR of approximately 48%. Profitability metrics show net margin of 31.95% and ROE of 15.26%, indicating strong operational efficiency and shareholder returns.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's differentiation includes: (1) Indigenous technology - first Chinese company to independently develop multifocal IOLs, breaking international monopolies; (2) Product quality and safety - high biocompatibility materials, superior optical designs, and rigorous quality control; (3) Comprehensive solutions - integrated product portfolio across surgical treatment, myopia control, and vision care addressing full patient lifecycle; (4) Market accessibility - competitive pricing and rapid distribution network covering 6,000+ institutions; (5) Innovation leadership - continuous R&D with 14 in-research projects at various development stages; (6) Customer support - strong clinical training and after-sales service.
